records.title: 【工具自荐】意扣（Equalang）：文档保留版式、网页对照与视频字幕翻译
records.description: Equalang is a side-by-side AI translator. It translates Word, PDF, PPT, Excel and other documents with their layout and structure intact: delivering editable Word translations, preserving columns, headers and footers, figure captions and paragraph hierarchy in PDFs, keeping text and tables editable with auto-fitted font sizes in PPT, and retaining numbers and formulas in Excel. It also offers bilingual web page translation, video subtitle translation on YouTube, Netflix, TikTok, Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), iQIYI (iq.com), Youku (youku.tv), Viki, WeTV, Crunchyroll and more, and in-place photo translation. Simultaneous interpretation runs right in the browser with nothing to install—for live listening at talks and meetings, face-to-face translation, and translated browser calls via an invite link—supporting Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French and many other languages. Sign up to get free translation credits.
